name: Issue 775: Windbreaker raises each Hurricane strike by 30% while Weapon Engraving: Air is active
contract: Windbreaker 804094 (passive) reads 'While Weapon Engraving: Air is active, the damage of each strike of your
Hurricane is increased by $s1% (30%).' Its only effect is a flat SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (12) modifier, BasePoints 29,
on family 38 mask1 0x4000, which Air Engraving 653223 carries: the equip spell of Weapon Engraving: Air's
enchant 999, active exactly while the engraving is. Air Engraving's second effect is a percent SPELLMOD_DAMAGE
modifier worth 0 whose class mask is empty in the client data. An empty mask matches every family 38
spell (SpellInfo::IsAffected), so before this change the +30 raised every Runemaster spell, the Hurricane
channel and Runeblade included, instead of only the strike. The only family 38 spell with mask2 0x4 is the Hurricane strike 645437, whose damage path applies
SPELLMOD_DAMAGE. Expected: with Windbreaker and Air Engraving the strike's damage modifier is 1000 -> 1300 and
its native melee damage bonus rises 30%; Windbreaker alone, Air Engraving alone, the Hurricane channel 645435 and
Runeblade 707141 stay at 1000. Learning or removing Windbreaker while the engraving is active updates it.
